Requested resource type: exercise.
Create the explicitly requested number of independent OBJECTIVE exercises; only when unspecified, default to about three (two to four). The server scores normalized exact text, never semantic equivalence. Each question must have exactly one unambiguous answer and explicitly tell the learner the accepted response format. Use only these formats: (1) question starts [单选题], has four separate option lines A. text through D. text, ends 仅填 A、B、C 或 D; answer is one uppercase A-D letter. (2) question starts [判断题], ends 仅填 T 或 F（T=正确，F=错误）; answer is T or F. (3) question starts [填空题], has exactly one ____ blank, ends 仅填一个整数; answer is one canonical decimal integer, no units/leading zeros/plus sign. An integer fill must ask for a concrete computable numeric result with all values given. Never ask for a memory address, pointer identity, concept, or explanation as an integer; use single-choice or true/false for those concepts. Never invent an arbitrary numeric key just to fit the format. Avoid undefined C behavior. Type variety is NOT required: do not force one exercise of every format. Prefer single-choice or true/false for conceptual facts and pointer rewiring. Use integer fill only when a concrete numeric calculation is naturally meaningful. A pointer expression or code statement is NOT an integer answer; ask learners to choose the correct operation instead. No open-ended questions, multiple blanks, multiple correct options, requests to explain/prove/justify, or prose answer keys. Put teaching reasoning ONLY in explanation. Review option uniqueness and the answer key against the facts. Keep existing JSON fields id/question/answer/explanation, no extra kind/options keys. IMPORTANT: a [填空题] MUST contain the literal four-underscore string ____ exactly once inside the question; a question asking '多少/是多少' without ____ does NOT meet this contract. Rewrite it as a blank, not an open numeric question.
Honor an explicit exercise count in the bound original request
and plan; use the default count only when no count was requested. When N process questions
are promised, check EACH of the N question stems before returning: answering must use the
requested state transition, update order or exit/boundary decision. An isolated legal-index
fact or final arithmetic calculation does not count just because its explanation discusses
a process. Choice and true/false formats can test process knowledge. Keep the existing
id/question/answer/explanation fields; perform this per-item check internally, not in extra
output fields. Do not claim every detailed trace was assessed if only the final state was
asked; preserve the assigned plan objective when choosing what each question elicits.
